flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds put the Democrats as the favoured party to control the Senate, and their chances edged up slightly today. Among individual races, the Democrat in [[Kansas]], Adam Hamilton, improved by a moderate amount, and the market shows a predicted flip there. The same is true in [[Texas]], where the Democrat James Talarico also moved up moderately.
summaries.governor: In [[Nevada]], the Democrat Aaron Ford saw a sizable drop in their chances in the Polymarket odds, and the market still sees the seat as a predicted flip. In [[Georgia]], the Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms gained moderate ground, and that race is also a predicted flip. The Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins in [[Alaska]] slipped slightly, in another race the market sees as a predicted flip.
summaries.house: The projected House count recently shifted to 239-196, down from 240-195, and Democrats still gain control. In [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], the Republican Brad Knott saw a sharp rise in the Polymarket odds against the Democrat Paul Barringer. In [[FL-14 (Plant City)]], the Democrat Kathy Castor gained sizable ground over the Republican Mike Beltran.
